about: Routing scenarios for ENTRY.md. tests/test_router.py checks offline that each expected row still offers the listed sections, template and runbook. tests/live/route_scenarios.sh sends the request to a fresh claude -p session and checks it picks the expected row. 'also' lists rows a session may reasonably pick instead.

scenarios.request: I have a vague idea: make onboarding faster for new engineers. Where do I start?
Plan a new CSV export feature for our reports page and get an agent to build it.
Fix the bug where the date filter drops the last day of the range.
Refactor the billing module into smaller files without changing behaviour.
Migrate 400 test files from Jest to Vitest with an agent.
Set up a Claude Code harness for my team from scratch.
Set up hooks so Claude can't say done while tests fail.
Run an agent overnight to work through our backlog of small issues.
Have an agent review this pull request before I merge it.
Research which vector database fits our search feature before we build anything.
My agent keeps retrying the same failing test and never finishes.
Our Claude bill tripled overnight. What do we do?
Change an API in our backend repo and update the three client repos that call it.
Onboard this new repo so agents can work in it.
Write an agent-ready issue for a dark mode toggle.
Run a retro on the task we just finished.
Review our agent setup for prompt injection and leaked secrets.
Three agents need to work on the same codebase at once without clobbering each other.
Write me a prompt I can hand to an agent to add pagination to our API.
